If the round-robin mode is daily, the outbound caller ID is changed every N days. Valid values: 1 to 30. If the round-robin mode is per-call, the outbound caller ID is changed every N calls. parameters.help_en: The four cloud number call modes. The array length is 4, which corresponds to the enabling status of the four cloud number outbound call modes (physical card, work card, two-way call, and RTC) in sequence. For example, [0,0,0,1] indicates that agents can only use the RTC outbound call mode. Note: You can set this property for agents only when the enterprise has enabled the cloud phone outbound call feature. Otherwise, agent creation fails
parameters.help_zh: 云号码四种呼叫模式；数组长度 为 4，依次对应云号码外呼的四种模式（实体卡、工作卡、两端呼、RTC)的开启状态； 例如：[0,0,0,1] 表示 座席只可使用 RTC 外呼模式。 注意：仅当企业开启了云手机外呼功能，才能为座席设置该属性，否则，座席将创建失败
parameters.name: cloud_number_modes

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the outbound call hang-up SMS feature. Valid values: 0: Disabled. 1: Enabled. When enabled, if an agent initiates an outbound call, the system sends an SMS message based on the configuration conditions in SMS Center > SMS Settings > Outbound Call Answered Notification or Outbound Call Unanswered Notification
parameters.help_zh: 外呼挂机短信开关 0：关闭， 1：开启。开启后，当座席发起外呼时，系统会依据【短信中心 - 短信设置 - 外呼双方接听通知 / 外呼客户未接听通知】中的配置条件发送短信
